record.original_question: What is the asymptotic behavior of the Kobayashi metric on finite-type domains in C^n?

evidence.quote: Problem 7.5.2 What’s the asymptotic behavior of k on finite type domains in Cn ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ be a smoothly bounded pseudoconvex domain of finite type (in the sense of D'Angelo), and let $k_\Omega : \Omega \times \mathbb{C}^n \to [0,\infty)$ denote the Kobayashi–Royden infinitesimal pseudometric, defined for $(z,v) \in \Omega \times \mathbb{C}^n$ by
$$k_\Omega(z,v) = \inf\{|\xi| : \xi \in \mathbb{C},\ \exists f : \mathbb{D} \to \Omega \text{ holomorphic with } f(0) = z,\ f'(0) = v/\xi\},$$
where $\mathbb{D} \subset \mathbb{C}$ is the unit disk.

Determine the precise asymptotic behavior of $k_\Omega(z,v)$ as $z \to \partial \Omega$, in terms of geometric invariants of $\partial \Omega$ at the boundary point being approached (such as the type, the Levi form, and the direction of $v$ relative to the complex tangential and normal directions). In particular, give sharp upper and lower bounds for $k_\Omega(z,v)$ near $\partial\Omega$ valid for all directions $v$, and identify the leading-order behavior in both the complex normal and complex tangential directions.
artifact.category_tag: Kobayashi metric on finite type domains
artifact.status_search_result: Significant partial results exist. Graham (1975) gave nontangential asymptotics on strongly pseudoconvex domains; Catlin and J. Yu (1990s) established sharp boundary estimates on certain weakly pseudoconvex finite-type domains in C^2 and on h-extendible (semiregular) domains. More recent work (Zimmer, Fiacchi, Wang and others, 2016–2024) obtained sharp Kobayashi estimates and Gromov hyperbolicity on convex domains of finite type. A complete asymptotic description for general smoothly bounded pseudoconvex finite-type domains in C^n (n ≥ 3) remains open beyond the h-extendible/convex settings.

status_evidence.title: Estimates of the Kobayashi metric and Gromov hyperbolicity on convex domains of finite type
status_evidence.snippet: Local estimates for the Kobayashi distance on bounded convex domains of finite type, precise up to bounded additive terms.
status_evidence.claim: Sharp Kobayashi estimates are now established for convex finite-type domains.

status_evidence.title: Weighted boundary limits of the Kobayashi–Fuks metric on h-extendible domains
status_evidence.snippet: Non-tangential boundary asymptotics of the Kobayashi–Fuks metric on h-extendible domains.
status_evidence.claim: Asymptotics are known on h-extendible (semiregular) finite-type domains.

status_evidence.title: Boundary Behavior of the Kobayashi–Royden Metric in smooth pseudoconvex domains
status_evidence.snippet: Studies boundary behavior on smooth pseudoconvex domains generalizing Graham's and Yu's results.
status_evidence.claim: General pseudoconvex finite-type case is studied but not fully resolved.
